items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: Yeah, his name is Edmund Washington.

ctx.x: I like music, see. When you like something, you're about to do good at it, see. I'm crazy about music. I don't know. Just like that. Now of course on Sunday I don't bother playing that drum on Sunday. I'm getting up at the churches. You know, like Reverend Washington, that white Baptist church back on the Charles and General Poetry. I get all the Poetry, I get all the churches. I'm pulling those jazz on Sunday. Unless I, you know, I'll be playing for it. So any night, like, like, next week, any night, like I come…
bands. As I said, I played in some first class bands.
